environment.description: Same Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate with task role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/export-worker-task. Feature configuration injected via AWS AppConfig hosted configuration profile 'export-service/production/feature-flags' with deployment strategy 'AllAtOnce'. The configuration document sets export.use_legacy_staging to false. AppConfig agent sidecar (v2.0.195) writes resolved config to /etc/app/features.json inside the task container at startup and polls every 30s. The ECS task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with explicit tmpfs mount at /tmp/export_staging (size 64MB, noexec,nosuid). Container runs as non-root (uid 10001) with no added Linux capabilities. The AppConfig configuration profile has a JSON schema validator that rejects any document where export.use_legacy_staging is not explicitly set to boolean false (validation constraint added as a Freeform validator lambda).

config.appconfig_validator: Lambda ARN validates export.use_legacy_staging === false, rejects deployment otherwise
